description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Order to impose Special Commodity levy on Other Black gram From 20.03.2018 for a Period of 06 months
categorisation: This gazette content is an order made under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, imposing a specific levy rate on commodities (Black gram) and rescinding a previous order. It deals with regulatory matters and statutory instruments, specifically the implementation and modification of an existing law, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name and title, it does not describe detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes, so it doesn't qualify for government-related classifications (Types 1-3).
